about_the_game:
You’re a former arms dealer, fresh out of prison and back in Blizwood with no cash, no product, and no connections. Rebuild your empire from the ground up, navigating between the watchful eyes of the authorities and the lure of profit.

Craft a variety of weapons, each with its own unique assembly process. Over time, gain access to improved materials and components to produce higher-quality, more profitable gear. Track how your creations impact the world by following reactions on social media.

Travel on foot, by BMX, or behind the wheel to deliver goods to your clients. Hire people to work the streets and grow your operations. In the later stages, set up cross-border smuggling routes to tap into new markets.

Purchase new properties for workshops and production facilities, hire staff, and build a fully automated manufacturing and logistics chain.

It’s a dangerous business — you’ll have to deal with inspections and raids.

content_descriptors.notes: This game depicts the simplified production, distribution and sale of illegal weapons. It also contains non-realistic violence in the form of melee and firearm combat.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 x64 / Windows 11 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700K / AMD Ryzen 5 1600X
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • Additional Notes: SSD required
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 x64 / Windows 11 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-11700 / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce RTX 4070 / AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT
  • Additional Notes: SSD required
